class.name: WResPath
class.brief_description: An opaque resource path that becomes an integer ID in native exports.
class.description:
Identifies a packaged project resource for [method @GDScript.load], [method @GDScript.preload], and [method @GDScript.async_preload]. Constant resource path strings convert implicitly to [WResPath]. Runtime strings, including paths assembled from variables, cannot be converted. Use [WResPath] for variables, parameters, and return types that carry resource paths. Select between constant paths when the resource depends on runtime input: [codeblock] func get_icon_path(selected: bool) -> WResPath: match selected: true: return "res://icons/selected.webp" false: return "res://icons/default.webp" return ""
func load_icon(selected: bool) -> Resource: return load(get_icon_path(selected)) [/codeblock] [WResPath] supports equality, truth checks, and membership in typed containers. String methods, concatenation, character indexing, and casts to [String] or numeric types are forbidden. The empty constant [code]""[/code] represents no resource and is false in truth checks. In the editor's GDScript runtime, the value is stored as a [String]. In gd2cpp native exports, it becomes an integer resource ID and packaged resource paths are remapped to numeric names. Treat the ID as opaque; select resources through constant paths in source code.
